description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 19.02.2018 to 25.02.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs calculations will be performed. The content involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements related to customs regulations, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
